May 19, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia

Wellcome Trust Ltd sold 200,000 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.10% with the market. The institutional investor held 1.82M shares of the technology company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $321.71 million, down from 2.02M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Wellcome Trust Ltd who had been investing in Facebook Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $528.79B market cap company.
